items.caption: This modern redraw presents 山 in a small-seal style: two outer strokes curve into a rounded base, while the taller central stroke extends below them. It illustrates a later stylized form of the mountain pictograph.
items.alt: Black small-seal-style 山 with two tall outer strokes curving into a rounded base and a taller central stroke extending below them.
items.selection_reason: The redraw shows a seal-style form listed in the character’s graphic history and makes the stylized mountain pictograph visible; it is not an ancient specimen.
items.period: Seal-script tradition; the file depicts a Shuowen seal-style form, without a specimen date

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an ancient inscription. The listed script forms are not individually dated here, and the evidence does not establish a continuous stroke-by-stroke development.
